summary: Allows admin users to create, edit, activate, deactivate, and view notification templates used for customer notifications.
useCases: Admin views a list of notification templates
Admin creates a new notification template with name, channel, subject, body, and status
Admin edits an existing notification template
validations: All required fields must be provided when creating or editing a template
Subject field is required if the channel is email
Only active templates can be used for sending notifications
businessRules: Only active templates are eligible for sending notifications
Deactivated templates cannot be used for sending notifications
openQuestions: What are the allowed values for the channel field beyond email? Are SMS and push notifications supported?
Should there be an activate endpoint or is activation done via create/edit with status field?
Is there a maximum length or format requirement for subject and body fields?
Should templates have versioning or audit history?
